build_feedforward_layer: build a feedforward neural network layer with configurable hidden dimension multiplier and activation function
build_linear_layer: build a linear layer with optional activation function and dropout using get_linear
build_activation_module: build an activation module from an Activation enum value using build_activation
get_no_weight_decay_params: get the set of parameter names to exclude from weight decay for a PyTorch model
get_normalization_layer: get a normalization layer class from a NormalizationType enum using get_normalization_layer
